reservations.composition: Compose the shared native accounting tables and usage semantics; do not create a second conflicting native_accounting schema.

reservations.feature: Service-native subscription identity and legacy configuration retirement
reservations.composition: Activate only after real migrations 26 and 27. Back up first, retire legacy subscription configuration atomically without inferring services, preserve historical attribution and configured-empty restrictions, and refuse unsettled native ownership or cleanup.

policy: Reservations are not executable. Implement in order, or revise the reservation sequence on main before starting replacements; never fill a gap with a no-op migration. An unmerged version-25 database is an unknown layout and requires preservation and explicit recovery.
